violated_contract: An optimistic deletion must remain suppressed until its mutation is acknowledged and a later authoritative read confirms absence. Treating a list omission during the pending mutation as acknowledgement lets a later stale read resurrect deleted rows; unconditional bulk rollback then inserts those rows a second time.
canonical_prevention: At the shared list owner, record the read ordinal when each deletion is acknowledged. Retire suppression only from a complete unfiltered read started afterwards, with no older projection reads outstanding. Restore failed mutations through one ID-aware restore primitive. Exercise delayed delete receipts, out-of-order reads and full/partial bulk failures through the production provider.
